task.description:
Design the implementation for IN-UI-05 (Event history tab), IN-UI-06 (Timeline tab), IN-UI-07 (Cancel instance), and IN-UI-08 (Auto-refresh) for the instance detail page.

Context: IN-UI-01 through IN-UI-04 are already RELEASED. The InstanceDetailPage.tsx already has:
- A tab structure with 'history' and 'timeline' tabs
- Basic event log table (needs filtering per IN-UI-05)
- Basic timeline feed (needs actor avatars and human-readable descriptions per IN-UI-06)
- A Cancel button (needs confirmation dialog and role gating per IN-UI-07)
- useCancelInstance hook with optimistic update already implemented
- useInstanceTimeline hook with cursor-based pagination

Requirements:
- IN-UI-05 MUST: Event history tab with filterable table (event type, time range), expandable raw JSON payload
- IN-UI-06 MUST: Timeline tab with vertical chronological feed, actor avatars, timestamps, human-readable descriptions
- IN-UI-07 MUST: Cancel button (operator+ role only), confirmation dialog, optimistic update with rollback
- IN-UI-08 SHOULD: Auto-refresh polling every 10s (configurable), last-refreshed indicator, manual refresh button

Classify each requirement against templates/lego-catalog.md. For Type B/D, produce parameter YAML files. For Type E, produce prose designs. All designs go to artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has a design artefact
Type classification is correct per lego-catalog.md
For Type E: no implementation code present, all public function signatures listed
Error taxonomy exists for each design

result.summary: Classified IN-UI-05 through IN-UI-08 as Type E (novel/cross-cutting). Produced 4 prose design artefacts covering event history filtering, timeline avatars, cancel confirmation dialog, and auto-refresh polling hook.
